---
title: "Étale Morphisms"
subtitle: ""
toc: false
---

Étale morphisms are the algebro-geometric analogue of local isomorphisms.
They preserve local dimension, introduce no infinitesimal ramification, and
often behave like covering maps (especially for finite \etale morphisms).


For a first pass, continue to
[Definitions and Intuitions](definitions-and-intuitions.qmd).
